title: Make the plan table readable: one name per plan, no promise of a plan that does not exist
description: On /pricing the cards are Starter, Pro and Enterprise, but the table header says Starter, Growth and Enterprise. The Pro card says "Everything in Zedu Free" and the Enterprise card says "Everything in Zedu Educator" — neither plan exists. Fix the names so one plan keeps one name, and every "Everything in" line points at a plan a buyer can pick. acceptedWorkstreams.description:

The read-only cybertron-integration checkout at 214cb297 has separate pricingData.ts and pricingComparisonData.ts under src/app/(homepage)/_lib, plus PricingCard and PricingComparisonTable components. These are inspection leads, not a completed fix.

Approach: ask the plan owner to confirm the canonical Starter/Pro/Enterprise identities and intended inheritance. Define stable plan IDs and a single display-name/inheritance mapping, then have cards, comparison headers and Everything in lines resolve from it. Do not rename Growth blindly if it denotes different entitlements. Where inheritance is not confirmed, remove the unsupported promise or ask for approved wording.

Deliver one bounded, reviewable patch with a before/after wording register and a regression check preventing labels for nonexistent plans. Include desktop/mobile screenshots and rendered-text checks across pricing and the reused homepage pricing block. Reuse the broad pricing-conversion and claim-register work; do not redesign pricing, change prices or add features.

Acceptance: one name per confirmed plan everywhere; each inheritance reference resolves to a selectable plan with confirmed entitlements; no outdated names remain in visible pricing copy; responsive table still works; relevant tests/type-check output is attached. Estimate 2-3 active hours after owner clarification and approved source/ticket. No deploy, subscription changes or invented plan decisions. Independent selection/review required before work or rewards.
